newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble dips amid settlement worries.
newsitem.headline: Rouble dips amid settlement worries.

text.p: The rouble eased on Thursday as trade was stalled by fears of non-payments after technical problems at the central bank's settlement centre and delayed payments by the government to the state savings bank Sberbank, dealers said.
Dealers said demand for roubles was subdued as some banks had not received current data on their accounts from the settlement centre of the central bank (RKTs).
"Trading was slow as banks feared non-payments, not knowing how their accounts are," an Interbank Finance House dealer said.

But another dealer said the rouble was easing for other than technical reasons as the nervousness had dissipated and the technical problems seemed to have been resolved. he said the central bank had informed banks about the current state of their accounts.

Roubles for today settlement were quoted at 5,393-96 per dollar compared with an early 5,391-94 and 5,388-90 late on Wednesday. Tomorrow roubles eased to 5,405-08 per dollar from yesterday's late 5,395-97.
The central bank said it had set 5,374-5,414 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Thursday.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 25-40 percent compared with Wednesday's late 60-80 percent.
